Both changes are in the form and it validates.

- **Main colour:** set to dark green `#1B5E20` (Apparence > Thème par défaut, "Couleur principale"). The form is in simplified colour mode, so the other palettes and text colours are recalculated from this value when the draft is saved.
- **Menu:** added a "Page libre" entry in the navigation bar (Barre de navigation), pointing to "Nos actions pour la jeunesse" (slug `jeunesse`). I left its label empty, so the menu shows the page's own title. I also left the new-tab option and the icon unset.

I didn't change the menu's existing Accueil and Catalogue de données entries, and I didn't touch the secondary or accent colours. The form isn't saved yet; saving the draft is still up to you.
